name: desmoslock
description: DesmosLock v2 workspace; legacy v1 remains evidence-only during the expand phase.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/domain && npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/contracts && npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/test-support
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/desktop && npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:repository && npm run test:unit && npm run test:evidence
scripts.test:repository: npm run test:clean-build && node --test tests/repository-contract.test.mjs tests/acceptance/required-check-probe.test.mjs tests/acceptance/unsupported-surfaces.test.mjs tests/acceptance/license-policy.test.mjs tests/acceptance/lint-guards.test.mjs tests/acceptance/legacy-packaging.test.mjs tests/acceptance/synthetic-backup.test.mjs tests/acceptance/postgres-backup-adapter.test.mjs tests/acceptance/local-supabase-output.test.mjs tests/acceptance/synthetic-backup-runtime.test.mjs tests/acceptance/unsigned-artifact-collector.test.mjs tests/acceptance/unsigned-artifact-evidence.test.mjs tests/acceptance/unsigned-artifact-cli.test.mjs tests/acceptance/desktop-native-build-targets.test.mjs tests/acceptance/universal-artifact-composition.test.mjs tests/acceptance/universal-artifact-cli.test.mjs tests/acceptance/signed-artifact-custody.test.mjs tests/acceptance/signed-artifact-evidence.test.mjs tests/acceptance/signed-artifact-cli.test.mjs
scripts.test:staff-auth: npm run test:db && npm run test:staff-auth:stack && npm run test:staff-auth:locks && npm run test:edge && npm run test:unit && npm run test:staff-auth:composed
scripts.test:edge: deno lint supabase/functions && deno test supabase/functions && deno check supabase/functions/health/index.ts supabase/functions/account-recovery/index.ts supabase/functions/staff-invitations/index.ts supabase/functions/student-session-challenge/index.ts supabase/functions/student-session-join/index.ts supabase/functions/student-session-read/index.ts supabase/functions/student-session-reconnect/index.ts supabase/functions/student-session-forfeit/index.ts supabase/functions/student-session-evidence/index.ts
scripts.test:web: npm run build:packages && DESMOSLOCK_PUBLIC_BACKEND_ENVIRONMENT=local DESMOSLOCK_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:43174 DESMOSLOCK_PUBLIC_WEB_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:43173 DESMOSLOCK_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr_cccccccc npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/web && vitest run apps/web && npm run test:web:e2e
scripts.test:electron: npm run build:packages && DESMOSLOCK_PUBLIC_BACKEND_ENVIRONMENT=local DESMOSLOCK_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:43175 npm run build --workspace @desmoslock/desktop && npm run test:runtime --workspace @desmoslock/desktop && vitest run apps/desktop && npm run test:electron:integration && npm run test:electron:production
